description: Cohort 1: Curated multi-tenant, multi-persona answerable golden evaluation dataset aligned strictly with the seeded Acme Corp and Globex Corp Markdown knowledge base.

items.question: What are the monthly uptime SLA, target P99 read latency, and durability for Acme Cloud Storage Mission-Critical tier?
items.reference_answer: Acme Cloud Storage Mission-Critical tier guarantees a 99.995% monthly uptime SLA, 18 ms target P99 read latency, and 11 nines cross-region durability across us-east-1 and eu-central-1.

items.question: What are the three control and data planes in Acme Cloud Storage Core Architecture?
items.reference_answer: Acme Cloud Storage separates metadata consensus from bulk block persistence across three planes: the Edge Ingress Gateway (TLS 1.3 and OAuth 2.0/JWT validation), the Metadata Raft Cluster (linearizable namespace locks and ACL policies), and the Erasure-Coded Block Store (64 MiB stripes with Reed-Solomon 10+4 parity encoding).

items.question: What HTTP method, endpoint path, and rate limit does Acme Cloud Storage use for Download Object?
items.reference_answer: Download Object uses HTTP GET on /v2/buckets/{bucket}/objects/{key} with a rate limit of 15,000 req/s.

items.question: How do I resolve ERR_409_CONFLICT lock contention in Acme Cloud Storage?
items.reference_answer: ERR_409_CONFLICT occurs when concurrent sync workers contend for an exclusive lease within the 1,500 ms Raft lease window. Inspect the active lease owner using acme-storage-cli locks inspect, force-expire stale leases older than 30 seconds with acme-storage-cli locks release, and resume sync with exponential backoff.

items.question: What causes ERR_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE and how should support mitigate backpressure saturation?
items.reference_answer: ERR_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE is triggered by ingress backpressure saturation when NVMe write-ahead queues exceed 85% capacity, returning a Retry-After header. Support should check queue depth via acme-storage-cli cluster queue-depth, enable read-only failover or throttle batch sync workers with --max-inflight-writes=16, and drain the overloaded primary shard if saturation persists over 120 seconds.

items.question: What are the raw capacity, max sequential throughput, and dual PSU power draw for SKU-9921-A?
items.reference_answer: SKU-9921-A is a 2U High-Throughput NVMe JBOF Array with 368.6 TB raw capacity (24 x 15.36 TB PCIe Gen5 NVMe), 110 GB/s max sequential throughput, and a nominal dual PSU power draw of 1,180 W at 208V AC (warning at 1,420 W, critical shutdown at 1,600 W).

items.question: What CLI command verifies BMC sensor health and firmware baselines on SKU-9921-A?
items.reference_answer: Run acme-hw-ctl inventory verify --sku SKU-9921-A --check-thermals --firmware-baseline v4.12.0 to query BMC sensor health and confirm SKU firmware baselines.

items.question: What are the Base Case Bid, Stretch Ceiling, and Walk-Away Cap enterprise values for Project Nimbus?
items.reference_answer: In Acme Corp's confidential Project Nimbus M&A financial model (valued at 6.8x forward ARR), the Base Case Bid is $142,000,000, the Stretch Ceiling is $165,000,000, and the Walk-Away Cap is $170,000,000 (rejected by Board).

items.question: What are Acme Corp's Q3 wholesale colocation commitments in Frankfurt DE-FRA-04 and Tokyo JP-TYO-02?
items.reference_answer: Acme Corp is committing to Frankfurt facility DE-FRA-04 (12.0 MW, $18,450,000 annual lease budget, 7-year term) and Tokyo facility JP-TYO-02 (8.5 MW, $14,200,000 annual lease budget, 5-year term).

items.question: What are the three integrated security modules in Globex Enterprise Threat Defense?
items.reference_answer: Globex Enterprise Threat Defense integrates three security modules: Inline Intrusion Prevention (IPS) for wire-speed TLS 1.3 inspection, Agentless Workload Posture Scanning for out-of-band CVE and secret drift detection, and the Continuous Compliance Engine mapping firewall telemetry to SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and PCI-DSS 4.0.

items.question: Which deployment profiles and compliance attestations does Globex Enterprise Threat Defense support?
items.reference_answer: Globex supports Globex-Cloud-Guard (AWS, GCP, Azure; SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001), Globex-Perimeter-IPS (on-premise and colocation; PCI-DSS 4.0 and HIPAA), and Globex-Hybrid-Mesh (multi-cloud and edge; FedRAMP Moderate Ready).

items.question: What causes ERR_401_SEC_REVOKED on Globex firewalls and what are the resolution steps?
items.reference_answer: ERR_401_SEC_REVOKED is triggered when an invalid or revoked egress mTLS client certificate fails OCSP/CRL validation during the policy handshake. Resolve it by running glx-fw-ctl cert verify --tenant-id globex_corp --error-code ERR_401_SEC_REVOKED --strict-egress-filtering, rotating the gateway certificate bundle, and verifying OCSP responder reachability.

items.question: How is the --enable-read-replica flag used with glx-fw-ctl daemon start for firewall policy sync failover?
items.reference_answer: During primary policy-controller maintenance or ERR_502_REPLICA_DESYNC recovery, run glx-fw-ctl daemon start --enable-read-replica --strict-egress-filtering --replica-sync-interval 2s so edge gateways perform local read-replica policy lookups.

items.question: What are the inspected TLS throughput, concurrent sessions, network interfaces, and power supply specs for SKU-GLX-500?
items.reference_answer: SKU-GLX-500 is a 2U Carrier-Grade Threat Gate supporting 200 Gbps inspected TLS throughput, 40,000,000 concurrent sessions, 8 x 100GbE QSFP28 plus 4 x 25GbE SFP28 interfaces, and dual 1,200W Platinum AC/DC hot-swap power supplies (780W typical load).

items.question: What are the throughput, power supply, and cooling specs for the SKU-GLX-100 Edge Sensor?
items.reference_answer: The SKU-GLX-100 Edge Sensor provides 10 Gbps inspected TLS throughput, 1,500,000 concurrent sessions, a single 250W internal AC power supply (95W typical load) with external DC failover, and front-to-back PWM cooling rated at 38 dBA nominal.

items.question: What are Globex Corp's initial offer, board max ceiling, and deal structure for TARGET-AEGIS-7?
items.reference_answer: For TARGET-AEGIS-7 (Cloud Identity & CIEM), Globex Corp's initial offer is $210,000,000 with a board max ceiling of $245,000,000 under a 75% Cash / 25% Equity deal structure, and legal counsel is authorized to include a $12,500,000 reverse break-up fee.

items.question: What does Globex Executive Board Directive BOARD-DIR-Q4-09 specify for escrow commitment and TARGET-SENTINEL-X?
items.reference_answer: BOARD-DIR-Q4-09 authorizes a $310,000,000 USD escrow commitment restricted to executive clean-room access and mandates retiring all legacy branch probes in favor of SKU-GLX-100 appliances within 90 days of closing TARGET-SENTINEL-X.
